comparisons.peer_summary: AMD continued investing in the open ROCm software stack, making key optimizations and adding features in the latest release to improve performance for generative AI workloads and simplify the developer experience.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose significant investment in software platforms specifically designed to accelerate generative AI workloads. AVGO's Tanzu Platform explicitly includes 'Tanzu AI Solutions' to help teams deliver generative AI applications, while AMD focuses its ROCm software stack optimizations on improving performance for 'generative AI workloads'.

sentences.text: • Tanzu Platform: This cloud native application platform accelerates software delivery, providing platform engineering teams with enhanced governance and operational efficiency while reducing toil and complexity for development teams. Tanzu Platform includes access to content including enterprise-ready curated distributions of open source software technologies used for storing and processing data. It also includes Tanzu AI Solutions, a set of capabilities that help application teams deliver generative AI-powered, intelligent applications quickly, safely, and at scale. Tanzu Platform also offers teams full-stack visibility from applications to infrastructure and efficient modern application lifecycle management across public and private clouds with Cloud Foundry and/or with any conformant Kubernetes.

During the year, we made several key optimizations and additional features in the latest AMD ROCm software that increases performance in key generative AI workloads, adds expanded support and optimization for additional frameworks and libraries, and simplifies the overall developer experience.

comparisons.peer_topic: Software strategy and open source contributions
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel aims to optimize AI frameworks and maintains the OpenVINO toolkit for deep learning inference. In 2024, Intel launched the Open Platform for Enterprise AI under the Linux Foundation and contributed oneAPI specifications to the UXL Foundation to enable open, multi-vendor programming across accelerators.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies highlight software strategies centered on generative AI infrastructure. AVGO’s Tanzu Platform offers 'Tanzu AI Solutions' for delivering generative AI applications, whereas Intel launched the 'Open Platform for Enterprise AI' to accelerate the deployment of generative AI use cases and maintains the OpenVINO toolkit for deep learning inference in generative AI.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company qualified and shipped 128GB DDR5 server modules and announced 256GB MRDIMM modules in 2024 to address bandwidth bottlenecks and generative AI demands, while also pioneering LPDDR adoption in servers.

MU addresses 'memory-intensive generative AI applications' with high-bandwidth DDR5 modules, whereas AVGO provides software tools ('Tanzu AI Solutions') to manage and deliver generative AI applications.
